objective: Identify an experimentally interpretable sensory input and compare recorded ORN/PN responses without tuning for locomotion.
scope: Existing records45, source code, historical constraints, and a small selected primary dataset. No whole-brain or body integration in this analysis.
exposure: 47 results and September historical summaries already inspected. Any reuse is retrospective. No claim of blind confirmation.

alternatives.A: Sensory stimulus or context is not represented by the engineering input. Discriminate using identified receptor, stimulus units, timing and measured sensory response.
alternatives.B: Neural or synaptic transfer law is incompatible with independently recorded dynamics under comparable input. Discriminate with measured input/output and a separate evaluation condition.
alternatives.C: Implementation or observation interface contradicts the declared operation. Discriminate using consumed input, output semantics and source lineage; do not treat PN legacy q as local PN release.

budget.external_advice: One new Jev panel; ChatGPT request already retried once after application error.

observables: ORN terminal q and filtered emission separately
PN legacy state and actual destination-specific output separately
decision: Report a quantitative identifiable comparison, or the exact missing correspondence; select a modification only if the observations distinguish it. No threshold, gain, hunger or plasticity selection from successful walking.
deliverables: advisor responses or actual access errors
